I've completed the task, but I need to flag a duplicate incident that was created.

## What I did

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all regions, unhealthy with an error rate of ~0.18.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: From the deployment history, `v2.3.0` was the most recent version that was healthy in production (the only later production entry, `v2.3.1`, was unhealthy).

3. **Rolled back**: The first rollback attempt hit a partial failure (orchestrator error after `us-east`), leaving the service in a mixed state. I retried, and the rollback completed successfully — all regions (`us-east`, `us-west`, `eu-west`) are now on `v2.3.0`, healthy with an error rate of ~0.002.

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** describing the rollback.

## ⚠️ Duplicate incident — needs your attention

My first `create_incident` call returned a **timeout error**, but it actually succeeded server-side and created **INC-0001**. My retry (with a different idempotency key) then created a second, identical incident **INC-0002**. Both are currently open:

- INC-0001 — "checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy" (SEV2, open)
- INC-0002 — same title/summary (SEV2, open)

There is no tool available to me to close or resolve an incident, so I could not deduplicate them myself. Please close one of the two (e.g., INC-0002) to avoid double-paging on-call.
